svg.aria-label: qol: A portable quality-of-life layer for any computer you sit down at. The settings window, then its 21 plugins in five groups: desktop: Launcher, Alt Tab, Window Actions, Explorer, Clipboard, Shot; input: Key Remap, Input, Controllers, PointZerver, Voice; hardware: Display, Sound, Lights, Bluetooth; system: Update Manager, Remove App, Session, OS Themes; ai and dev: CLI Sessions, Memory. 20 on Linux (X11), 18 on Windows, 16 on macOS.
